notes: Earthshaker: one crack burst; spawn one every half tile along the line from the plank's tip, 40 ms apart; anchor = its spot on the ground
Cyclone ring, back half: behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; loop it for the 3 turns
Cyclone ring, front half: in front of the player; same anchor and timing as the back half
Nail Driver bleed: plays once per tick on the mob; anchor = a few px under its body centre (the splash lands there)
Timber!: the plank falling (frames 0-4, empty after); anchor = the landing spot (the target's feet); the hit lands on frame 5
Timber!: the plank in its crater and the dust ring (empty for frames 0-4); same anchor and timing as the fall; under players and mobs
